name: 3S Chaos Sea
author: Joakim
description: Chaos sea stepper: maps rooms on a 3D grid, queues unexplored exits, BFS-walks to the nearest frontier room; auto mode fights mobs on the way. Reads the room, its contents and combat from GMCP, and takes its arrival signal from the MUD's own room header - so none of the '=S=', '=M=', '=P=' or '=A|W|I=' display markers need to be switched on. Those triggers remain as a fallback for a character or MUD without GMCP, each standing down for any room GMCP has already described. Which exits are still unexplored comes from the server rather than from dead reckoning: in the sea an exit's destination is 0 until you have walked it, so the frontier survives the coordinate collisions a dead-reckoned map cannot avoid.
